title: Scanner UI + cart scroll + live table status
summary: Cleaner staff table scanner (dark viewfinder, no broken oval). Mobile POS cart scrolls inside the sheet. Floor tables go Dining when you add items to a selected table.
highlights: Staff table scan: dark square viewfinder, Snap photo + live cam, less clutter
Mobile cart: fixed bottom sheet — cart lines scroll, menu stays put
Floor: table turns Dining when cart has items + table selected
Cloud occupancy uses real order ids (no broken cart_/seat_ PK hashes)
